{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.08

|arg= local

|descr= Return the turret lock target.
{{Feature|informative|The command is local to the '''turret''', not the vehicle.}}

|gr1= Camera Control

|s1= vehicle [[lockedCameraTo]] turretPath

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]. Use an empty array to select the gunner's turret by default

|r1= Can be one of:
* [[Nothing]] - not locked
* [[Object]] - if locked to an object
* [[Position#PositionASL|PositionASL]] - if locked to a position

|x1= <sqf>vehicle player lockedCameraTo [];</sqf>

|seealso= [[lockCameraTo]]
}}
